peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 24.3% below its local comparables; 3 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,790,000 ($1,694 psf, 1,636–1,646 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,238 psf (range $1,472–2,798); 24.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $896,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Siglap MRT about 400 m, Marine Terrace MRT about 910 m; closer than 347 of 462 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Ngee Ann Primary School about 950 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Marine Terrace about 1,110 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area D about 450 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 1,860 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 1,940 m; Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 1,940 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 200 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 395 new sales and 554 resales (949 purchases); new sales were 41.6% of these purchases. Subsales (16) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 554 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 136 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 554 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 609 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
